findings.reason: Frequencies by condition come from groups of 60 to 170 cards, where sampling noise is wide (a 4.2-sigma interval is about 20 points for a mid-range rate), so the interval does the work there. z is 4.2, not 2.58: a report has about 750 cells, and a per-cell 99% interval fails an exact reference library by chance (seen on three seeds of 1 000 cards; z 2.58 gave 2, 1 and 3 failed cells). 4.2 makes that about 1 in 50 libraries or fewer, and with the floor of 5 points far fewer. A model that makes patients too typical or tests too accurate is off by 15 points or more in the cells it affects.

continuous.reason: Measured findings are checked as the share below the reference median (expect 50%) and p90 (expect 90%). Values are rounded to 0.1 and clamped to the variable's range, which creates ties (counted half), so the floor is looser than for binary shares.

accuracy.reason: Realised sensitivity, specificity and categorical accuracy against the per-attempt reference (resolved under the card's own facts and active conditions). Rates are right by construction in guided mode, so a 5-point floor flags a model that over- or under-states test accuracy (the expected drift in free mode) without failing sampling noise. Cells with fewer than 20 positives or negatives are skipped.

non_diagnostic.reason: Non-diagnostic rates are small (a few percent), so the floor is 2 points; a test with no rate in the catalogue must show none (an expected 0% makes any excess outside the interval).

state_consistency.reason: A hard rule of resolution (C8 rule 3): no symptom appears and no resolved cause remains because a state changed. Not a statistical quantity, so no violation is accepted.

presenting.reason: A patient cannot complain of a symptom they do not truly have in that state; false reports belong to the history test, which has its own specificity. Hard rule, no violation accepted.

diversity.reason: Cards with identical background and findings to an earlier card. Some repeats are expected for healthy primaries with few positive findings; above 2% the library is repeating itself.

leak.reason: Notes that name the hidden diagnosis without a finding that reveals it (validator rule card_reveals_condition). The validator already warns per card; 2% of notes is the most a library may carry before the notes cannot be shown as unrevealed.

background_realism.reason: Added for review w7 M4 (not part of the catalogue hash). Pack-years that do not fit the card's age, and never-smokers with pack-years, are impossible: no violation accepted. The smoking mix and the share of patients 65 and over or under 50 are compared with the population file (populations/<id>.yaml) given each card's own age, sex and condition, with the same interval and 5-point floor as the frequency checks. At most 10% of cancer cards may be under 50 (Finland: a few percent; the old generator gave 22%).

report_wording.reason: Built-in default (review w7 B1); the catalogue's tolerances file may override it.
